mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, code, approve_status, source_code, source_id, so_code, so_id, invalid_status, customer_id, customer_name, approve_user_id, approve_user_name, approve_time, change_reason
mapper.select: with base_id as ( SELECT sdnd.id, sdnd.source_detail_id from so_delivery_notice_change sdnc inner join so_delivery_notice_change_detail sdncd on sdnc.id = sdncd.main_id LEFT join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdnd.id = sdncd.source_detail_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false where sdnc.is_deleted = false and sdncd.is_deleted = false and sdnc.id = #{id} ), notice_aggregates AS ( SELECT source_detail_id, SUM(delivery_qty) AS all_notice_qty FROM so_delivery_notice_detail WHERE is_deleted = false and source_detail_id in (SELECT source_detail_id from base_id) GROUP BY source_detail_id ), picking_aggregates AS ( SELECT source_detail_id, SUM(qty) AS picked_qty FROM picking_detail WHERE is_deleted = false and source_detail_id in (SELECT id from base_id) GROUP BY source_detail_id ) SELECT sdncd.id AS detailId, sdncd.source_detail_id AS sourceDetailId, sdncd.so_detail_id AS soDetailId, sdncd.sku_id AS skuId, sdncd.sku_no AS skuNo, sdncd.product_name AS productName, sdncd.change_type AS changeType, sdncd.new_qty AS newNoticeQty, sdncd.bom_version AS bomVersion, sdncd.platform_sku_no AS platformSkuNo, sd.box_qty AS saleQty, COALESCE(na.all_notice_qty, 0) AS allNoticeQty, COALESCE(sdnd.delivery_qty, 0) AS currentNoticeQty, COALESCE(pa.picked_qty, 0) AS pickedQty, sd.remark FROM so_delivery_notice_change sdnc INNER JOIN so_delivery_notice_change_detail sdncd ON sdnc.id = sdncd.main_id LEFT JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd ON sdnd.id = sdncd.source_detail_id AND sdnd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN so_detail sd ON sd.id = sdncd.so_detail_id AND sd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN notice_aggregates na ON na.source_detail_id = sdnd.source_detail_id LEFT JOIN picking_aggregates pa ON pa.source_detail_id = sdnd.id WHERE sdnc.is_deleted = false AND sdncd.is_deleted = false AND sdnc.id = #{id}
